title: Maytag — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Maytag.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "What Dependability Looks Like." Maytag has positioned itself as the dependability brand since 1893. The Extra Power button is unique — press it on any cycle and it boosts stain-fighting with an extra wash action and more time. Their commercial heritage means they build residential machines to commercial-grade durability specs. The Maytag Man advertising campaign is the longest-running in appliance history.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers who are tired of appliances breaking. Families with kids and heavy laundry loads. Buyers who want no-nonsense performance over flashy features.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Maytag:

• Extra Power button — one press boosts any cycle with extra stain-fighting action

• Dual Power Filtration in dishwashers — a chopper blade AND a filter for the dirtiest loads

• Built to last — commercial heritage means residential machines are overbuilt

• Most Dependable in the industry — backed by the longest-running service reputation

• PowerWash agitator in top-loaders — nothing cleans work clothes better
